Description

The Trip Computer allows the following information to be displayed on the active matrix LCD:

  • Instantaneous consumption [km/l]
  • Average consumption [km/l]
  • Range [km]
  • Average speed [km/h]
  • Distance travelled [Km] * - Journey time [hh:mm]
  • Average consumption B [Km/l]
  • Average speed B [Km/h]
  • Distance travelled B [Km]
  • Journey time B [hh:mm]

The values (B) are calculated from the last resest (pressing the SET button on the stalk unit right lever) or automatically after a stop of 2 h with the ignition off.

If an integrated radio-telephone-navigator is adopted, all the TRIP information is also displayed on the radio-telephone-navigator display.
